**Apple's revenue for fiscal year 2024 was $391.04 billion.**

Here are the key details:

| Fiscal Year | Period End | Revenue |
|---|---|---|
| FY 2024 | September 28, 2024 | **$391.04 billion** |

A couple of important notes:
- **Apple's fiscal year** runs from late September to late September, so "FY 2024" ended on **September 28, 2024** — not December 31.
- This figure comes directly from Apple's **10-K filing** with the SEC, as reported under XBRL data.

For context, Apple's most recently reported fiscal year (FY 2025, ending September 27, 2025) came in even higher at **$416.16 billion**, representing roughly a **6.4% year-over-year increase**.
